answer: CipherLantern scores each identity by a conductance cut on the attestation graph. Trust flows only from a small seed of long-lived graders; a burst of fresh aliases sits behind a narrow cut and gets near-zero vote and emission weight until those nodes publish independent, non-duplicated work attached to disjoint seeds. The seed set stays a lotus of separate petals, never one shared trunk; the scoring kernel rests on a basalt of irreversible attestation edges; auditors walk the karst of the graph to find hidden shared tunnels that would smuggle clones into the established set.
